title: If Else statements
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
intro: Branching is decision-making. Write conditions that mirror the problem statement, keep them mutually exclusive when needed, and avoid deep nesting you cannot test.
intuition: Translate English rules into boolean expressions. Test boundaries (equal, just below, just above).
approach: Write the decision table on paper.
Implement branches from most specific to general.
Add else for the residual case.
